senses.gloss: private meeting, esp. privacy between man and woman.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 11:1:3">Y. Keth. XI, beg. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>דברים של יי׳</he> private attendance, e.g. assistance at washing and ointing.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:1:10">Y. Sot. I, 16ᶜ</cite> top <he>אין זה י׳</he> this is no ascertained private meeting (with her former husband, on account of which a second letter of divorce would be required).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 21a">Snh. 21ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>גזרו על הי׳ ועל וכ׳</he> they forbade privacy (with a married woman) and with a single woman.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 21a">Ib.</cite> <he>י׳ דאורייתא הוא</he> is not privacy with a married woman biblically interdicted?—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:4">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>מלקין על הי׳ … משום הי׳</he> we punish private meetings between a man and a woman, but we do not prohibit the wife to her husband on account of her private meeting with a man.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>בעלה בעיר אין חוששין משום י׳</he> if her husband is in town, we do not consider her private meeting with a man a suspicious act; a. fr.—<he>בְּיִ׳</he>
<cite ref="Beitzah 22b">Bets. 22ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 37a:4">Pes. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>שאילית את רבי בי׳</he> I asked my teacher privately.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: (later Hebr.) י׳ השם declaration of the unity of God. Pesik. Zutr., Nitsabim, end.—[Gen. R. s. 99, end כיחודו של עולם, read: כיחידוֹ, v. יָחִיד.]
